[[File:Rotkan_visa.jpg|thumb|A Rotkan visa stamp in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]] on an Intergalactic Passport]]
The '''Euclidean Complex''' was located in [[Rotkan]]. It was divided in sectors such as [[AC-20]], [[AC-21]] and [[AC-25]]. Visitors to the Euclidean Complex had to have visas stamped on their [[Intergalactic Passport]]s in order to enter Rotkan and were to be accompanied by guides at all times, and in the case of those entering through AC-20 to AC-25, had their belongings held at entry.
